The '''TD series bath''' was a type of [[Oil bath/Legends|oil bath]] manufactured by [[Fryil Industries]]. Several sizes were available for purchase depending on the size of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] needing to be serviced.<ref name="CFTD" />
